nonblocking_findings: A4-1 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:103-138 and plan.md task 1.15 F5: The F5 claim that preview.sh maps an unreadable docs entry to a refusal line holds only for a dangling entry (the bash `find` scan at preview.sh:103-107). An unreadable file under docs (mode 000) makes `cp -a` fail at preview.sh:112: exit 1, a `cp: cannot open ... Permission denied` line on stderr, and a half-built preview folder (assets, index.html, methodology.html were present in my probe). The Python branch `preview: unreadable` at preview.sh:129-138 calls `sys.exit(2)`, but the script imports hashlib, html, json, and os only (preview.sh:119-122), so `sys` is undefined. That branch would raise NameError and it is unreachable by any test. No file is written under docs, so the failure is safe. The test B2-1 for preview.sh covers only the dangling case. Fix: add `import sys`, or remove the dead branch; run a readability scan (for example `find ... ! -readable`) before the copy and refuse with `preview: unreadable <path>`; add a test for an unreadable file.

A4-2 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:93-99: The planted-symlink scan also matches a valid symlink that `cp -a` copied from docs. With a symlink docs/alias.html -> index.html in a temp copy, the first preview gave exit 0 and the second preview gave `preview: refused path <preview>/alias.html`, exit 2. The tracked docs tree holds 0 symlinks (git ls-files -s docs, mode 120000: 0 entries), so the effect is none today. Fix: copy with `cp -aL`, or refuse a docs symlink in the first run.

A4-3 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:93 (readdirSync in the walk): The B2-1 fix wraps statSync and the hash read but not readdirSync. An unreadable directory under docs (mode 000) gave exit 1 with `Error: EACCES: permission denied, scandir .../docs/lockdir` and a stack trace in a temp copy. No file is written. It is the same family as B2-1 at a new place. Fix: wrap the readdirSync call and push the directory path to the broken list.

A4-4 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide-tests/preview-gate.test.ts (test `A3-3 refuses a symlink planted ...`): The test checks exit 2, an unchanged docs snapshot, and one non-empty stdout line. It does not check the text `preview: refused path <link>` that preview.sh:9-10 and plan.md task 1.15 F3 state. A change of the line text would still pass. The docs-write part of the test fails on aa894a7, so the fix itself is pinned. Fix: assert the exact line with the link path.
